title: Subcontracting Note — material issued to a subcontractor
description: The buying side's stock movement: components leave a warehouse of ours and go out to be worked on. It is a document of its own rather than a stock entry purpose because it cites a commitment (the subcontracting purchase order) and a supplier, which a bare stock movement does not — and because the material is still ours while the subcontractor holds it, so the note is what the reconciliation reads.

supplier.description: The subcontractor the material is issued to. It is the same party family as any other supplier, because it is paid on a purchase order like any other.

against_purchase_order.description: The subcontracting order the issue is against. Required: material leaves only against a commitment.

from_warehouse.description: The warehouse of ours the material is issued from.

to_warehouse.description: The subcontractor's location, when the model tracks it. Absent means the material is held at the subcontractor outside our warehouses.

rate.description: The valuation the issue is written at. Optional: the posting layer falls back to the item master's valuation rate.

harvest: material issued to a subcontractor against a purchase order
the source warehouse a subcontracting issue moves stock out of
x-erp-provenance.note: Field and lifecycle shapes from the upstream subcontracting surface, re-expressed as our own schema and workflow data. No upstream file was read into this repository; no upstream code, schema or text is copied.
